notes: I1 is met by the paper's own gravimetric (Hiden IGA-003, 77 and 87 K) and volumetric (Quantachrome iSorbHP1, 273-323 K up to 170 bar) H2 uptake measurements. Every uptake value is for URJC-3, a Co(II) azobenzene-tetracarboxylate MOF, which is not a carbon sorbent (section 3), so I2 fails and the code is not_carbon (first applicable code in section 4 order). I3 and I4 are met for URJC-3 but do not change the outcome. The paper's pressure for the 77 K value is stated inconsistently (16 bar in text, 18 bar in Table 2 caption, 20 bar in Conclusions); this does not affect I3. is_retracted is false in record.json and no retraction notice appears in the PDF. Not a review; no statement that the uptake values were previously published.
